purpose: Bounded owner decision context for interpretation beside the evidence-bound Grounded Brain.

provenance.numberingRule: Earlier text teaching items and later audio questions are separate namespaces and must not be silently renumbered into one sequence.

items.summary: Automation of monitoring, calculations and reporting is both an operating improvement and a future Company Curator capability; automated metrics still require provenance, reconciliation and exception handling.

Companies are built for long-horizon retention, productive cash flow and compounding rather than 6-12 month exits; selected productive assets may be accumulated and locked while thesis and economics remain intact.
Strengthening may target foundation assets, productive/dividend assets, stable reserves or a combination rather than one universal allocation.
BTC, ETH, gold and potentially silver are recurring foundation candidates for generated-income reinvestment, while productive or mixed reinvestment remains valid.
Roughly $50-$100 rewards versus about $3-$5 gas can be a practical batch example, but urgency and opportunity cost can justify earlier harvesting; there is no hard threshold.
Defitea rewards are intended to accumulate through end-August 2026 unless invalidated, with later review of quantity, token price, USD value, gas, realised amount and reinvestment destination.
Company income should be related to protocol activity and economics where mechanism-specific causality exists, not only headline APR.

Peer owners were reported as favoring long reward accumulation and long-horizon productive-asset exposure; this is not independently recorded testimony and must remain separate from Holding-owner Decision DNA.
YieldRing is viewed as similar in spirit to layered capital architecture; future reward use to strengthen BTC is a hypothesis to observe rather than a confirmed decision.
Learning should combine autonomous telemetry, accounting, Ask evaluation, owner teaching, pre-outcome decisions, later outcomes and separately-attributed peer experience.
Gas is evaluated contextually rather than by one percentage rule; absolute fee, harvest size, urgency, opportunity and liquidity needs all matter.
Non-stable reward tokens may accumulate when capital has no immediate target use, preserving upside optionality, while token-specific fundamentals and opportunity cost remain reviewable.
Early harvesting can be justified by high-conviction deployment opportunities, collateral/HF needs, new assets, RWA/venture opportunities or genuine personal liquidity needs.
A stable-value liquidity buffer is desirable but company-specific; 5%, 10% and 20% were illustrative levels, with buffer building in strong markets and progressive deployment in declines.
Allocation among existing assets, new assets and productive stables is driven by relative opportunity and market context rather than a fixed reinvestment split.
Productive protocol allocations tend toward roughly comparable sizing where practical, while foundation assets may intentionally be larger; this is a diversification bias, not equal-weight policy.
Peer owners were reported as favoring long-lived company development, productive locks, reinvestment and stronger layered balance sheets; preserve as peer context until independently observed.
Core architecture should be relatively stable while protocol/company adaptations occur more frequently; one weak component should not automatically invalidate the whole architecture.
No specific material historical reversal was identified yet; future questioning should revisit concrete decisions rather than inventing a lesson.
Clear strategic errors include major unclear/meme/scam exposure or excessive single non-foundation concentration; a bad protocol outcome does not by itself prove the ex-ante company strategy was bad.
About one month is a normal minimum in many cases, while multi-month or even roughly one-year accumulation can be acceptable when there is no earlier capital need.
Desired signals include protocol economic changes, approximately >10% daily company TVL moves, every $10 reward-value milestone, price-vs-quantity reward attribution and material concentration drift.
Signals should be separated into informational, review and strategy-review classes rather than flattened into alarms.
Public/company intelligence should increasingly explain why yield, balance, rewards and concentration changed and surface genuine decision points while preserving provenance.
Open topics include categorical high-yield exclusions, precise cash-flow-state semantics, one concrete repeatable historical decision and continued refinement of decision-point metrics.
